notes: Dixon County (State Auditor), cash basis, FY ended June 30, 2024. Statement p4 Total Governmental Funds column; beginning/ending are cash basis fund balances. ending_investments 7,022,708 (p3) is informational and already inside ending cash. Balance sheet: Statement of Cash Basis Assets and Fund Balances - Governmental Funds (p3) Total column; totals equal the p1 Statement of Net Position. Detail: General Fund budget schedule (p5-6), Taxes 4,792,876 split using the p4 General Fund column (budget 5,161,541 is for the whole line, so budget_final null on the pieces); Wakefield Cops Grant had no actual (budget 100,000) so no line; major funds Road & Bridge, Inheritance, County Health Insurance (p7-8); Inheritance Fund disbursements 94,392 split by function from the p4 Inheritance column (GG 87,290, PS 7,102; budget 3,179,798 for the whole line). Nonmajor funds via Total Nonmajor Funds column of the combining statement (p14-17) since there are 24 funds; per-fund nonmajor budget schedules (p9-13) not recorded to avoid double counting.
